prompt: Give me a quick environment snapshot: the value of PATH, the value of HOME, and a list of running processes owned by the 'www-data' user.

function.name: read_env
function.description: Read the value of a single environment variable. If `name` is omitted, returns a JSON object of {name: value} for every env var. Sensitive variables are redacted to '<redacted>'.

function.name: list_processes
function.description: Return a snapshot of running processes as a JSON array of {pid, user, command}.
